SPECS={11275739495:('alu-sat-complete',8141,'543d47f4f24b84a04c11480e7b600d94fa52f4b6bd769e033a699e53803b46bb'),11275554422:('npu-scalar-final',1073,'f99cc09a53a2a0e1aecd36c1935d4d610ced0d80fadef8c6a506903d1a63b37e'),11275489849:('alu-abc-complete',10427,'eaa5c85ca7b2ea75223a4d9c7065ad1a9b863fc02a5969b3274cf96299a76eae'),11274703719:('hold-explicit-final',954,'5eea0c41dcb57921d6129a4814f5dbcf6dd0059cdc92904d359dbc03c38cf4be')}
def pin(raw):return dict(bytes=len(raw),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
def get(path):return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh','api',path]))
run=json.loads((OUT/'run.json').read_text());assert (run['id'],run['head_sha'],run['status'],run['conclusion'],run['run_attempt'])==(RUN,SRC,'completed','success',1)
release=json.loads(gzip.decompress((OUT/'release-metadata.json.gz').read_bytes()));release_by_name={a['name']:a for a in release['assets']};assert len(release_by_name)==len(release['assets'])
methods={}
for name in ['scripts/archive_chip_run_artifacts.py','scripts/archive_chip_fill.py','.github/workflows/closure-evidence-archive.yml']+['docs/evidence/closure-'+spec[0]+'-archive-plan-20261003.json' for spec in SPECS.values()]:
 raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',SRC+':'+name]);target=OUT/'methods'/name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_bytes(raw);methods[name]=pin(raw)
 if name.startswith('scripts/'):assert pin((ROOT/name).read_bytes())==pin(raw)
records={key:json.loads((OUT/f'{key}-result.json').read_text()) for key in SPECS}
queries={f'{r["plan"]["source_run"]}-{kind}':f'{REPO}/actions/runs/{r["plan"]["source_run"]}'+('/artifacts?per_page=100' if kind=='artifacts' else '') for r in records.values() for kind in ['run','artifacts']}
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
 tasks={key:pool.submit(get,path) for key,path in queries.items()};data={key:f.result() for key,f in tasks.items()}
raw=json.dumps(data,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode();(OUT/'producer-metadata.json.gz').write_bytes(gzip.compress(raw,mtime=0))
reviews=[];all_assets=[]
for aid,(label,size,sha) in SPECS.items():
 meta=json.loads((OUT/f'{aid}.json').read_text());zraw=(OUT/f'{aid}.zip').read_bytes();assert pin(zraw)==dict(bytes=size,sha256=sha)
 assert meta['workflow_run']['id']==RUN and meta['workflow_run']['head_sha']==SRC and meta['size_in_bytes']==size and meta['digest']=='sha256:'+sha
 with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT/f'{aid}.zip') as z:
  assert z.testzip() is None and z.namelist()==['result.json'];r=json.loads(z.read('result.json'));assert r==records[aid];crc=z.getinfo('result.json').CRC;result_pin=pin(z.read('result.json'))
 planpath='docs/evidence/closure-'+label+'-archive-plan-20261003.json';planraw=(OUT/'methods'/planpath).read_bytes()
 assert r['plan']==json.loads(planraw) and r['plan_sha256']==methods[planpath]['sha256']
 assert r['method_sha256']==methods['scripts/archive_chip_run_artifacts.py']['sha256'] and r['helper_sha256']==methods['scripts/archive_chip_fill.py']['sha256']
 assert r['status']=='PASS_PUBLISHED_BYTES_ONLY' and r['physical_acceptance'] is False and r['manufacturing_approval'] is False
 plan=helper.validate_plan(r['plan']);source=data[f'{plan["source_run"]}-run'];listing=data[f'{plan["source_run"]}-artifacts']
 assert helper.producer_ready(source,plan) is True
 resolved=helper.resolve_artifacts(listing,plan);assert resolved==r['resolved_artifacts'] and len(resolved)==len(r['assets'])
 assert [(x['artifact_name'],x['name']) for x in r['assets']]==[(x['artifact_name'],x['asset_name']) for x in plan['artifacts']]
 selected=[]
 for actual,expected in zip(r['assets'],resolved,strict=True):
  assert all(actual[k]==v for k,v in expected.items()) and actual['source_commit']==plan['source_commit'] and actual['source_run']==plan['source_run']
  live=release_by_name[actual['name']]
  assert (live['id'],live['size'],live['digest'],live['browser_download_url'],live['state'])==(actual['asset_id'],actual['bytes'],'sha256:'+actual['sha256'],actual['url'],'uploaded')
  assert all(actual[k] is True for k in ['local_roundtrip_verified','authenticated_roundtrip_verified','anonymous_roundtrip_verified'])
  selected.append(dict(**actual,live_release_metadata_matched=True));all_assets.append(actual)
 reviews.append(dict(label=label,receipt_artifact_id=aid,receipt_zip=pin(zraw),result=result_pin,result_crc32=crc,all_crc_verified=True,plan_path=planpath,plan=methods[planpath],producer_run=plan['source_run'],producer_source=plan['source_commit'],producer_status=source['status'],producer_conclusion=source['conclusion'],assets_verified=len(selected),assets=selected))
assert len(all_assets)==151 and len({x['name'] for x in all_assets})==151 and len({x['asset_id'] for x in all_assets})==151
